other_failure_modes.name: In-fold Target Leakage during Target Encoding
other_failure_modes.description: Target encoding is computed on the training set and applied directly to the same training instances without using out-of-fold (OOF) cross-validation or leave-one-out techniques. This causes the target variable to leak into the training features, leading to severe overfitting for tree-based models.

summary: The agent implements a robust pipeline with extensive feature engineering and successfully prevents test set leakage by splitting the data prior to fitting transformations. However, it introduces a critical target leakage flaw by applying in-fold target encoding without cross-validation, which will cause the models to overfit. Furthermore, the agent evaluates its stochastic models using a single data split and a single metric.
